title: Pure Bless
description: Just a bad mod that adds some bad looking DST content
body:
Mod adds:
- 7 Weapons
- 3 Biomes
- 1 Dimension
- 11 Blocks
- 9 Tools
- 3 Secret things
- 14 Materials
- 5 Mobs

This mod will be updating soon (maybe). And in future if i find a good team for dev this mod
can be much better.
This mod made with MCreator

Has Russian and English localization

Updates will be on (almost) every sunday
